releaseNotes: Flow Client v1.3.3: Resolved updater process termination & infinite wait loops, eliminated unintended background process kills, converted remote image loading to smooth non-blocking async, fixed global Java path & JVM argument resolution, hardened WebView2 mod browsing against timeouts, synchronized instance selection on deletion, prevented concurrent duplicate game launches, fixed skin avatar MTA thread safety, fully localized all settings and UI text to English, and linked top search bar to version explorer.
